title: Bundle manifest v3 (variant spine + evidence view)
$comment: Structural residue of the evidence.* / claims.* bundle rules (P0-1, P0-0 invariants 5/11, P0-1 invariant 21) with the P0-2 lifecycle extension. v3 makes the selected variant spine, claim contract, input-snapshot refs (with anchor status and time_basis, claims.offline-snapshot.policy-only), the EvidenceViewID, and a durable commitment (auditor signature or signed checkpoint, claims.vector.durable-commit) explicit, so an offline verifier fetches exact variants and can check the boundary commitment. The P0-2 extension (liveness.offline.no-current-verified) adds optional lifecycleEvidence, observationEvidence, and trustProfileSnapshot so historical acceptance is reproducible from the bundle; a current-state scope MUST NOT be VERIFIED from a bundle (semantic, pinned by vector). The anchorStatus and timeBasis enums are now fixed by the P0-2 decision. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref). v1/v2 reads remain supported (evidence.bundle.reader-first); v3 is not asserted verifiable by a v1/v2 reader.

canonicalizerId.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids (P0-4 inv7): the canonicalizer contract id (jcs-rfc8785), carried so an offline verifier dispatches on the same canonicalizer.

cryptosuiteId.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids / claims.suite.contract-id: the cryptosuite claim contract id.

schemaVersion.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids: the schema version the verdict was evaluated under.

spine.$comment: evidence.manifest.spine: the selected (BodyAddress, WireVariantID) spine the exporter fetched exact variants for.

inputSnapshotRefs.$comment: claims.offline-snapshot.policy-only: carried snapshots are policy state; the bundle states anchor status and time_basis and does not imply trusted observation time. The enums are now fixed by the P0-2 decision.

anchorStatus.$comment: observation.record.commits / observation.order.cross-log-bridge: whether the carried snapshot is anchored in an observation order. UNANCHORED and INDETERMINATE cannot back a historical VERIFIED.

timeBasis.$comment: observation.trusted-time.profile: what the time claim rests on. OBSERVATION_ORDER is append order only (no wall-clock), TRUSTED_OBSERVATION_TIME needs a contracted time authority, POLICY_SNAPSHOT is carried policy state with no time claim.

commitment.$comment: claims.vector.durable-commit: the evidence view crossing the bundle boundary is committed by an auditor signature or a signed checkpoint reference.

lifecycleEvidence.$comment: liveness.offline.no-current-verified: DID/key lifecycle excerpts or signed checkpoints the historical verdict depended on. Optional (present for a historical-acceptance bundle); carrying it never licenses a current-state VERIFIED.

observationEvidence.$comment: liveness.offline.no-current-verified / observation.membership.proof: the observation records and order evidence (inclusion proof or replay to a checkpoint) that anchor the variant spine.

trustProfileSnapshot.$comment: liveness.offline.no-current-verified: the trust-profile snapshot the verdict was evaluated under, so an offline re-derivation uses the same profile.
